distractors.text: So he relocated Yueyang Tower, enlarged its old structure, and engraved on it the poems and fu of worthy men of the Tang and his own time.
distractors.explanation: 「重修」是重新修建，非「迁移」；relocated 把修楼理解成搬家

distractors.text: So he rebuilt Yueyang Tower, expanded its old regulations, and engraved on it the poems and fu of worthy men of the Tang and his own time.
distractors.explanation: 「旧制」指原来的规模体制，非「旧规章制度」；regulations 是抽象制度，与「增」不搭配

distractors.text: So he rebuilt Yueyang Tower, reduced its old structure, and engraved on it the poems and fu of worthy men of the Tang and his own time.
distractors.explanation: 「增」是扩大，reduced 正好反义

distractors.text: And sometimes the long mist clears entirely, the bright moon shines over a hundred li, floating light leaps like gold and the still reflection sinks like a disc of jade, as fishermen's songs answer one another—such joy is boundless!
distractors.explanation: 「千里」是极言其远，百 li 把量级缩小了十倍

distractors.text: And sometimes the long mist clears entirely, the bright moon shines over a thousand li, floating light sinks like gold and the still reflection leaps like a disc of jade, as fishermen's songs answer one another—such joy is boundless!
distractors.explanation: 「浮光跃金，静影沉璧」是对偶：浮动的光像跳动的金，静止的影像沉下的璧；把「跃」和「沉」对调，动者静、静者动

distractors.text: And sometimes the long mist clears entirely, the bright moon shines over a thousand li, floating light leaps like gold and the still reflection sinks like a disc of jade, as fishermen's songs answer one another—such joy is not boundless!
distractors.explanation: 「此乐何极」是反问，意为快乐无穷；加了 not 变成「并非无穷」

distractors.text: Its many peaks to the southeast, with woods and ravines of exceptional beauty, look lush, deep and graceful—that is Langya.
distractors.explanation: 「西南」是西南方向，southeast 换成了东南

distractors.text: Its many peaks to the southwest, with woods and ravines of exceptional beauty, look lush, deep and graceful—that was Langya.
distractors.explanation: 判断句「…者，…也」表当下认定，用 was 把现在判断译成过去

distractors.text: Its many peaks to the southwest, with woods and ravines of exceptional beauty, look lush, deep and graceful—that is not Langya.
distractors.explanation: 原句是肯定判断，加 not 变成否定

distractors.text: As the path winds round the peaks, there stands a pavilion perching like a bird with spread wings below the spring—that is the Old Drunkard's Pavilion.
distractors.explanation: 「临于泉上」是居高临下、在泉之上；below 把位置弄反

distractors.text: As the path winds round the peaks, there stands a pavilion perching like a bird with spread wings above the spring—that was the Old Drunkard's Pavilion.
distractors.explanation: 判断句用 was 把现在认定译成过去

distractors.text: As the path winds round the peaks, there stands a pavilion perching like a bird with spread wings above the spring—that is not the Old Drunkard's Pavilion.
distractors.explanation: 原句是肯定判断，加 not 变成否定

distractors.text: The Old Drunkard's intention is not in the wine, but in the hills and streams.
distractors.explanation: 「意」在此指情趣、真意，非「打算、意图」；intention 把「意趣」读成了「计划」

distractors.text: The Old Drunkard's heart is not in the hills and streams, but in the wine.
distractors.explanation: 「不在酒，在乎山水」是舍酒取山水，颠倒后变成舍山水取酒

distractors.text: The Old Drunkard's heart is in the wine, but in the hills and streams.
distractors.explanation: 「不在酒」的否定脱落，同时留下 but 使前后自相矛盾

distractors.text: To be close to petty men and keep worthy ministers at a distance—this is why the Earlier Han flourished;
distractors.explanation: 「亲贤臣，远小人」是亲贤远佞，把两组人对调后变成亲佞远贤

distractors.text: To be close to worthy ministers and keep petty men at a distance—this is why the Earlier Han declined;
distractors.explanation: 「兴隆」是兴盛，declined 把结果译反

distractors.text: To be close to worthy ministers and keep petty men at a distance—this is not why the Earlier Han flourished;
distractors.explanation: 「此…所以…也」是肯定判断，加 not 变成否定

distractors.text: to be close to worthy ministers and keep petty men at a distance—this is why the Later Han collapsed.
distractors.explanation: 「亲小人，远贤臣」把两组人对调，变成亲贤远佞

distractors.text: to be close to petty men and keep worthy ministers at a distance—this is why the Later Han flourished.
distractors.explanation: 「倾颓」是衰败，flourished 译为兴盛，因果正好相反

distractors.text: to be close to petty men and keep worthy ministers at a distance—this is not why the Later Han collapsed.
distractors.explanation: 原句是肯定判断，加 not 变成否定

distractors.text: Later, I encountered setbacks in the military, took on heavy responsibilities before the army was defeated, and accepted the mission at a critical moment. Since then, it has been a full 21 years.
distractors.explanation: 「受任于败军之际」是在兵败之际受任，before 把同时关系改成先后

distractors.text: Later, I encountered setbacks in the military, took on heavy responsibilities when the army was defeated, and accepted the mission at a critical moment. Since then, it has been a full twelve years.
distractors.explanation: 「二十有一年」即二十一年（21），twelve 把数字读错

distractors.text: Later, I encountered setbacks in the military, took on heavy responsibilities when the army was not defeated, and accepted the mission at a critical moment. Since then, it has been a full 21 years.
distractors.explanation: 「败军之际」是兵败之时，加 not 变成未败

distractors.text: There may be about a hundred fish in the pool, all seeming to swim in empty air with nothing to feed on; the sunlight pierces straight to the bottom, and their shadows spread on the stones.
distractors.explanation: 「无所依」是无所凭依、像悬空一样，非「没有食物」；feed on 把凭依读成觅食

distractors.text: There may be about a hundred fish in the pool, all seeming to swim in empty air with nothing to rest on; the sunlight pierces straight to the bottom, and their shadows spread above the stones.
distractors.explanation: 「影布石上」是影子映在石面上，above 把「在石上」变成「在石头上方悬着」

distractors.text: There are exactly a hundred fish in the pool, all seeming to swim in empty air with nothing to rest on; the sunlight pierces straight to the bottom, and their shadows spread on the stones.
distractors.explanation: 「可百许头」是大约百来条，exactly 把约数读成确数

distractors.text: Sitting above the pool, with bamboo and trees enclosing it on two sides, solitary and empty of people, it chills the spirit and freezes the bone, mournful, still and profound.
distractors.explanation: 「四面」是四周围合，two sides 把四面减成两面

distractors.text: Sitting above the pool, with bamboo and trees enclosing it on all sides, solitary and empty of people, it chills the spirit and warms the bone, mournful, still and profound.
distractors.explanation: 「凄神寒骨」是心神凄凉、寒气透骨；warms 把「寒」译成暖

distractors.text: Sitting above the pool, with bamboo and trees enclosing it on all sides, solitary though not empty of people, it chills the spirit and freezes the bone, mournful, still and profound.
distractors.explanation: 「寂寥无人」是空寂无人，加 not 变成「并非无人」

distractors.text: His fellow villagers said: Those who eat meat will plan this matter themselves, why should you get involved?
distractors.explanation: 「肉食者」借指有权位的贵族，非字面的「吃肉的人」

distractors.text: His fellow villagers said: Those in power will plan this matter themselves, why should you be separated from them?
distractors.explanation: 「间」在此是参与、插手，非「间隔、分离」

distractors.text: His fellow villagers said: Those in power will not plan this matter themselves, why should you get involved?
distractors.explanation: 「谋之」是他们会谋划，加 not 变成他们不谋划

distractors.text: Cao Cuo said: Those in power are vulgar and cannot think far ahead.
distractors.explanation: 「鄙」在此是见识浅陋，非「粗俗、庸俗」；vulgar 把「浅陋」读成品行评价

distractors.text: Cao Cuo said: The meat-eaters are short-sighted and cannot think far ahead.
distractors.explanation: 「肉食者」借指当权者，直译 meat-eaters 丢了借代义

distractors.text: Cao Cuo said: Those in power are short-sighted and can think far ahead.
distractors.explanation: 「未能远谋」是不能远谋，删掉否定后与「鄙」自相矛盾

distractors.text: Cao Qufu replied, "This is only doing one's duty, and one can fight only a single battle."
distractors.explanation: 「可以一战」是可以凭这个打一仗，「一战」指这一战，不是「只能打一次」

distractors.text: Cao Qufu replied, "This belongs to the category of loyalty, and one can fight."
distractors.explanation: 「忠之属也」是「属于尽职分的事」，category 把判断句读成分类学表述

distractors.text: Cao Qufu replied, "This is only doing one's duty, and one can not fight."
distractors.explanation: 「可以一战」是肯定判断，加 not 变成不能一战

distractors.text: Blue dye is taken from the indigo plant, yet is less blue than the plant itself;
distractors.explanation: 「青于蓝」是比蓝草更青，less 把超越译成不如

distractors.text: Blue dye is taken from the indigo plant, yet is bluer than the sky;
distractors.explanation: 「青于蓝」的比较对象是蓝草，换成 sky 偷换了参照物

distractors.text: Blue dye is not taken from the indigo plant, yet is bluer than the plant itself;
distractors.explanation: 「取之于蓝」是从蓝草中提取，加 not 变成不是取自蓝草

distractors.text: A teacher is the reason the Way is transmitted, learning imparted, and doubts dispelled.
distractors.explanation: 「所以」在此是「用来…的（凭借）」，非表原因的「原因」；the reason 把「凭借」读成「起因」

distractors.text: A teacher was one who transmits the Way, imparts learning, and dispels doubts.
distractors.explanation: 判断句「…者，…也」表当下定义，was 把现在定义译成过去

distractors.text: A teacher is not one who transmits the Way, imparts learning, and dispels doubts.
distractors.explanation: 原句是肯定定义，加 not 变成否定

distractors.text: the common crowd of today, far above the sages, yet feel ashamed to learn from teachers.
distractors.explanation: 「其下圣人」是低于圣人，above 把高低弄反

distractors.text: the common crowd of today, far below the sages, yet feel no shame in learning from teachers.
distractors.explanation: 「耻学于师」是以从师为耻，no shame 把「耻」译成「不以为耻」

distractors.text: the common crowd of today, not far below the sages, yet feel ashamed to learn from teachers.
distractors.explanation: 「亦远矣」是差得远，加 not 变成差得不远

distractors.text: but for himself he is ashamed to take a teacher—how enlightened!
distractors.explanation: 「惑矣」是糊涂，enlightened 译成明白，感叹的方向反了

distractors.text: but for himself he is proud to take a teacher—how deluded!
distractors.explanation: 「耻师」是以从师为耻，proud 把耻译成荣

distractors.text: but for himself he is not ashamed to take a teacher—how deluded!
distractors.explanation: 「耻师焉」是以从师为耻，加 not 后变成不以为耻

distractors.text: Ask why, and they say: he and he are of similar age, and their paths alike.
distractors.explanation: 「道相似」指学问、修养相近，非字面的「道路相似」

distractors.text: Ask why, and they say: he and he were of similar age, and their learning alike.
distractors.explanation: 引述的是当下的说法，were 把现在判断译成过去

distractors.text: Ask why, and they say: he and he are not of similar age, and their learning alike.
distractors.explanation: 「年相若」是年纪相仿，加 not 变成年纪不相仿

distractors.text: Hence a disciple must not be inferior to his teacher, nor the teacher superior to his disciple; the order of understanding the Way differs, and each has his speciality—that is all.
distractors.explanation: 「不必」是未必、不一定，不是「一定不」；must not 把或然读成禁止

distractors.text: Hence a disciple need not be inferior to his teacher, nor the teacher superior to his disciple; the order of understanding the Way differs, and each has only one speciality—that is all.
distractors.explanation: 「术业有专攻」是各有专门研究，only one 把它缩成「只懂一门」

distractors.text: Hence a disciple need be inferior to his teacher, nor the teacher superior to his disciple; the order of understanding the Way differs, and each has his speciality—that is all.
distractors.explanation: 「不必不如师」是未必不如师，删掉否定后变成「应该不如」

distractors.text: Li Pan, a youth of seventeen, loves the ancient prose, and has studied all the classics and their commentaries of the Six Arts; bound by the fashion of the times, he studies with me.
distractors.explanation: 「不拘于时」是不被时俗拘束，删掉 un- 后变成受时俗束缚

distractors.text: Li Pan, a youth of seventy, loves the ancient prose, and has studied all the classics and their commentaries of the Six Arts; unbound by the fashion of the times, he studies with me.
distractors.explanation: 「年十七」是十七岁，seventy 把十七读成七十

distractors.text: Li Pan, a youth of seventeen, loves the ancient prose, and has not studied all the classics and their commentaries of the Six Arts; unbound by the fashion of the times, he studies with me.
distractors.explanation: 「皆通习之」是全都通习，加 not 变成没有全学

distractors.text: In the autumn of the year renxu, on the full moon of the seventh month, Master Su and his guest boated beneath the Red Cliff.
distractors.explanation: 「既望」是十六日、满月之后，on the full moon 把它读成十五日当天

distractors.text: In the autumn of the year renxu, just after the full moon of the seventh month, Master Su and his guest boated above the Red Cliff.
distractors.explanation: 「游于赤壁之下」是在赤壁之下泛舟，above 把「之下」翻成「之上」

distractors.text: In the autumn of the year renxu, just before the full moon of the seventh month, Master Su and his guest boated beneath the Red Cliff.
distractors.explanation: 「既望」是望日之后，before 把「已过」译成「未到」

distractors.text: The guest said: "'Bright the moon, sparse the stars, as southward fly the crows'—is this not the verse of Cao Mengde's trapping of Zhou Yu?
distractors.explanation: 「困于周郎」是被周郎所困，施受倒置后变成孟德困住周郎

distractors.text: The guest said: "'Bright the moon, sparse the stars, as northward fly the crows'—is this not the verse of Cao Mengde's strait at Zhou Yu's hands?
distractors.explanation: 「乌鹊南飞」是向南飞，northward 把方向弄反

distractors.text: The guest said: "'Bright the moon, sparse the stars, as southward fly the crows'—is this the verse of Cao Mengde's strait at Zhou Yu's hands?
distractors.explanation: 「此非…乎」是反问，意为「这不正是…吗」，删 not 后反问的语气与答案都反了

distractors.text: We are mayflies lodged between heaven and earth, mere grains of sand in the vast ocean.
distractors.explanation: 「一粟」是一粒谷子，sand 换成沙粒，把「粟」的比喻对象改了

distractors.text: We are duckweed lodged between heaven and earth, mere grains in the vast ocean.
distractors.explanation: 「蜉蝣」是朝生暮死的蜉蝣，duckweed 换成浮萍

distractors.text: We are not mayflies lodged between heaven and earth, mere grains in the vast ocean.
distractors.explanation: 原句是自比蜉蝣，加 not 后比喻被否定

distractors.text: I mourn the brevity of my life, and mourn the endless Yangtze.
distractors.explanation: 「羡」是羡慕，译成 mourn 后与前半句同向，丢了「羡长江之无穷」的反衬

distractors.text: I mourn the brevity of my life, and envy the finite Yangtze.
distractors.explanation: 「无穷」是无穷无尽，finite 正好反义

distractors.text: I celebrate the brevity of my life, and envy the endless Yangtze.
distractors.explanation: 「哀吾生之须臾」是哀叹短暂，celebrate 把哀译成庆

distractors.text: Knowing this cannot easily be won, I entrust my lingering notes to the sorrowful wind.
distractors.explanation: 「骤得」是突然得到，非「容易得到」

distractors.text: Knowing this cannot suddenly be lost, I entrust my lingering notes to the sorrowful wind.
distractors.explanation: 「骤得」是骤然得到，lost 把「得」译成「失」

distractors.text: Knowing this can suddenly be won, I entrust my lingering notes to the sorrowful wind.
distractors.explanation: 「不可乎骤得」是不可骤然得到，删掉否定后正相反

distractors.text: Master Su said: "Do you too not know, sir, the water and the moon?
distractors.explanation: 原句是正面发问「你也懂得吗」，加 not 变成「你也不懂吗」

distractors.text: Master Su said: "Do you only know, sir, the water and the moon?
distractors.explanation: 「亦」是「也」，表同样；only 把「也」读成「只」

distractors.text: Master Su said: "Are you too acquainted with, sir, the water and the moon?
distractors.explanation: 「知」在此是懂得其中的道理，acquainted with 弱化成「认识、熟悉」

distractors.text: if from the side of the unchanging, then all things and I are finite—so what is there to envy?
distractors.explanation: 「皆无尽也」是都无穷尽，finite 正好反义

distractors.text: unless from the side of the unchanging, then all things and I are endless—so what is there to envy?
distractors.explanation: 「自其不变者而观之」是「从不变的一面看」，条件关系被换成 unless（除非）

distractors.text: if from the side of the unchanging, then all things and I are endless—so what is not there to envy?
distractors.explanation: 「而又何羡乎」是「那还羡慕什么」，加 not 变成「那不羡慕什么」，反问落空

distractors.text: Moreover, between heaven and earth each thing has the same owner; if it is not mine, though but a hair, I will not take it.
distractors.explanation: 「物各有主」是各有一主，the same owner 变成「同一个主人」

distractors.text: Moreover, between heaven and earth each thing has its owner; if it is not mine, though but a single coin, I will not take it.
distractors.explanation: 「虽一毫」是极言其微（一根毫毛），coin 换成货币单位，失了比喻

distractors.text: Moreover, between heaven and earth each thing has its owner; if it is mine, though but a hair, I will not take it.
distractors.explanation: 「苟非吾之所有」是「若不是我的」，删掉否定后变成「若是我的」，整句逻辑反转

distractors.text: Within a single day, within a single palace, the climate was not orderly.
distractors.explanation: 「气候不齐」是冷热不一，不是「不整齐」；orderly 把温度差异读成秩序

distractors.text: Within the first day, within the first palace, the climate differed from place to place.
distractors.explanation: 「一日之内，一宫之间」的「一」是「同一、整个」，不是序数「第一」

distractors.text: Within a single day, within a single palace, the climate was the same throughout.
distractors.explanation: 「不齐」是不一致，the same 把否定译成肯定

distractors.text: Why, in taking, did they overlook even the smallest grain, and in spending squander it like mud and sand?
distractors.explanation: 「尽锱铢」是连极少的也搜刮干净，overlook 反而成了「看不上、忽略」

distractors.text: Why, in taking, did they scrape even the smallest grain, and in spending squander it as much as mud and sand?
distractors.explanation: 「用之如泥沙」是像扔泥沙一样挥霍，as much as 把比喻读成数量比较

distractors.text: Why not, in taking, scrape even the smallest grain, and in spending squander it like mud and sand?
distractors.explanation: 「奈何」是「为什么竟」，表诘责；why not 变成建议「何不」，语气反了

distractors.text: The men of Qin had no time to mourn themselves, so later men mourned themselves.
distractors.explanation: 「后人哀之」是后人哀叹秦人，mourned themselves 把对象换成后人自己

distractors.text: The men of Qin disdained to mourn themselves, so later men mourned them.
distractors.explanation: 「不暇」是来不及、顾不上，不是「不屑」；disdained 换成态度评价

distractors.text: The men of Qin had time to mourn themselves, so later men mourned them.
distractors.explanation: 「不暇自哀」是顾不上自哀，删掉否定后意思正相反

distractors.text: Thus the lords' land was limited, but Insistent Qin's appetite was tireless; the more they fed it, the fiercer it pressed them.
distractors.explanation: 「无厌」是永不满足，tireless 变成「不疲倦」，褒贬与搭配都变了

distractors.text: Thus the lords' land was limited, but Insistent Qin's appetite was insatiable; the more they fed it, the softer it pressed them.
distractors.explanation: 「侵之愈急」是侵略越急迫，softer 正好反义

distractors.text: Thus the lords' land was not limited, but Insistent Qin's appetite was insatiable; the more they fed it, the fiercer it pressed them.
distractors.explanation: 「诸侯之地有限」是土地有限，加 not 后与下文「奉之弥繁」的困境脱节

distractors.text: Hence Yan, though a small state, fell first—the effect of its use of arms.
distractors.explanation: 「后亡」是最后才亡，first 把次序弄反

distractors.text: Hence Yan, though a small state, fell last—the cost of its use of arms.
distractors.explanation: 「斯用兵之效也」是肯定这是用兵得当的功效，the cost 把功效读成代价

distractors.text: Hence Yan, because a small state, fell last—the effect of its use of arms.
distractors.explanation: 「虽小国」是「虽然是小国」表让步，because 改成因果，与「后亡」的转折关系冲突

distractors.text: With such an advantage, yet terrorised by Qin's accumulated might, they grew daily, expanded monthly, drifting toward ruin.
distractors.explanation: 「日削月割」是天天被削、月月被割，grew/expanded 把削减译成增长

distractors.text: With such an advantage, yet terrorised Qin's accumulated might, they were pared daily, carved monthly, drifting toward ruin.
distractors.explanation: 「为秦人积威之所劫」是被秦的积威所胁迫，去掉被动后变成「胁迫了秦的积威」

distractors.text: With such an advantage, yet terrorised by Qin's accumulated might, they were pared daily, carved monthly, drifting toward prosperity.
distractors.explanation: 「以趋于亡」是走向灭亡，prosperity 正好反义

distractors.text: Those who rule states—let them be terrorised by accumulated might!
distractors.explanation: 「无使」是别让（自己）被胁迫，删掉否定后成了祈使对方被胁迫

distractors.text: Those who rule states—let them always be terrorised by accumulated might!
distractors.explanation: 「无使」的告诫被译成 always，从警戒变成怂恿

distractors.text: Those who rule states—let them never be terrorised by accumulated prestige!
distractors.explanation: 「积威」是靠积累形成的威势、威压，prestige 是正面的声望，褒贬反了

distractors.text: At that time Lord Shang aided him: within, he established laws and statutes, devoted to ploughing and weaving, and prepared implements of defence and war; without, he formed the Lianheng alliance and fought the lords.
distractors.explanation: 「斗诸侯」是使诸侯互相争斗，fought 变成自己去打，丢了使动用法

distractors.text: At that time Lord Shang aided the lords: within, he established laws and statutes, devoted to ploughing and weaving, and prepared implements of defence and war; without, he formed the Lianheng alliance and set the lords against one another.
distractors.explanation: 「佐之」是辅佐秦国国君，aided the lords 把辅佐对象换成诸侯

distractors.text: At that time Lord Shang aided him: within, he established laws and statutes, devoted to ploughing and weaving, and prepared implements of defence and war; without, he formed the Lianheng alliance and set the emperor against one another.
distractors.explanation: 「诸侯」是各诸侯国，emperor 把列国换成一统的皇帝，制度层级错

distractors.text: Therefore, Qin clasped its hands in salute and took the vast expanse of land west of the Yellow River.
distractors.explanation: 「拱手」是两手一合、毫不费力，salute 读成拱手行礼

distractors.text: Therefore, Qin was as easily able to obtain the vast expanse of land south of the Yellow River as if it were using two hands to clap.
distractors.explanation: 「西河之外」指黄河以西之地，south 把方位弄错

distractors.text: Therefore, Qin was not as easily able to obtain the vast expanse of land west of the Yellow River as if it were using two hands to clap.
distractors.explanation: 原句极言其易，加 not 后变成「没那么容易」

distractors.text: Not loving precious vessels, treasures, and rich lands, they gathered the talents of the world, who bound themselves in the North-South alliance and became as one.
distractors.explanation: 「不爱」是不吝惜，不是「不喜欢」；loving 取字面义

distractors.text: Not stinting precious vessels, treasures, and rich lands, they gathered the talents of the world, who bound themselves in the North-South alliance and broke off relations.
distractors.explanation: 「缔交」是缔结邦交，broke off relations 正好反义

distractors.text: Stinting precious vessels, treasures, and rich lands, they gathered the talents of the world, who bound themselves in the North-South alliance and became as one.
distractors.explanation: 「不爱」是不吝惜，删掉 not 后 stinting 成了「吝惜」，与「以致天下之士」矛盾

distractors.text: So the vertical alliance was formed, the alliance was destroyed, and each competed to cede land to bribe Qin.
distractors.explanation: 「从散」是合纵解散，was formed 把解散译成结成

distractors.text: So the vertical alliance broke up, the alliance was destroyed, and each competed to seize land to bribe Qin.
distractors.explanation: 「割地」是割让土地，seize 把割让译成夺取

distractors.text: So the vertical alliance broke up, the alliance was not destroyed, and each competed to cede land to bribe Qin.
distractors.explanation: 「约败」是盟约败坏，加 not 后前后两句互相矛盾

distractors.text: South he seized the lands of the Baiyue, regarding them as the commanderies of Guilin and Xiang;
distractors.explanation: 「以为」是「以之为」即把它设为，regard as 只是「当作」，没有实际设置

distractors.text: North he seized the lands of the Baiyue, making them the commanderies of Guilin and Xiang;
distractors.explanation: 「南取」是向南攻取，north 把方向弄反

distractors.text: South he seized the lands of the hundred Yue peoples, making them the commanderies of Guilin and Xiang;
distractors.explanation: 「百越」是南方越族各部的总称，hundred 把它读成「一百个越族」

distractors.text: After the First Emperor died, his lingering might shook regions of the same customs.
distractors.explanation: 「殊俗」是风俗不同的边远地区，the same customs 把「殊」译成「同」

distractors.text: Long after the First Emperor died, his lingering might shook regions of different customs.
distractors.explanation: 「既没」是死了以后不久，Long after 把时间拉远

distractors.text: After the First Emperor died, his lingering might did not shake regions of different customs.
distractors.explanation: 「余威震于殊俗」是仍然震慑边远地区，加 not 后反义

distractors.text: whose talents surpassed the ordinary man's, having neither the worth of Confucius or Mo Di nor the wealth of Tao Zhu or Yi Dun,
distractors.explanation: 「不及中人」是比不上普通人，surpassed 正好反义

distractors.text: whose talents fell short of the ordinary man's, having both the worth of Confucius or Mo Di and the wealth of Tao Zhu or Yi Dun,
distractors.explanation: 「非有」是没有，both...and 把双重否定译成「两者兼有」

distractors.text: whose talents fell short of the ordinary man's, having neither the worth of Confucius or Mo Di nor the worth of Tao Zhu or Yi Dun,
distractors.explanation: 「陶朱、猗顿之富」是财富，第二个 worth 把「富」也译成「贤」，与前句重复

distractors.text: They hadn't reached a decision on what to do, so they tried to find an envoy to send to the Qin state to take revenge, but couldn't find one.
distractors.explanation: 「报秦」是回复、答复秦国，take revenge 读成报复

distractors.text: They hadn't reached a decision on what to do, so they tried to find an envoy to send to the Qin state to reply, and found one.
distractors.explanation: 「未得」是没找到，and found one 把结果译反

distractors.text: They had reached a decision on what to do, so they tried to find an envoy to send to the Qin state to reply, but couldn't find one.
distractors.explanation: 「计未定」是计策还没定，删掉否定后变成已定

distractors.text: Miao Xian, the Chief Eunuch, said: 'My retainer Lin Xiangru can be appointed.'
distractors.explanation: 「可使」是可以出使，appointed 换成「任命官职」

distractors.text: Miao Xian, the Chief Eunuch, said: 'My retainer Lin Xiangru can not be sent.'
distractors.explanation: 「可使」是举荐他可以出使，加 not 后成了否定举荐

distractors.text: Miao Xian, the Chief Minister, said: 'My retainer Lin Xiangru can be sent.'
distractors.explanation: 「宦者令」是宦官的首领，Chief Minister 读成宰相

distractors.text: Miao Xian replied: 'I once committed a crime and secretly planned to flee to Yan. My retainer Xiangru stopped me, saying: How do you know of the King of Yan?'
distractors.explanation: 「何以知燕王」是凭什么结交、了解燕王，know of 弱化成「听说过」

distractors.text: Miao Xian replied: 'I once committed a crime and secretly planned to pass through Yan. My retainer Xiangru stopped me, saying: How do you know the King of Yan?'
distractors.explanation: 「亡走燕」是逃奔燕国，pass through 把投奔读成路过

distractors.text: Miao Xian replied: 'I once earned merit and secretly planned to flee to Yan. My retainer Xiangru stopped me, saying: How do you know the King of Yan?'
distractors.explanation: 「尝有罪」是曾经有罪，earned merit 把有罪译成立功

distractors.text: Xiangru said to me: 'Zhao is strong and Yan weak, and you bring fortune to the King of Zhao, so the King of Yan wished to befriend you.'
distractors.explanation: 「幸于赵王」是被赵王宠幸，bring fortune to 把受宠译成赐福，施受倒置

distractors.text: Xiangru said to me: 'Zhao is strong and Yan weak, and you enjoy the King of Zhao's favour, so the King of Yan wished to fall out with you.'
distractors.explanation: 「结于君」是想结交您，fall out with 把结交译成结怨

distractors.text: Xiangru said to me: 'Zhao is not strong and Yan weak, and you enjoy the King of Zhao's favour, so the King of Yan wished to befriend you.'
distractors.explanation: 「赵强而燕弱」是赵强燕弱，加 not 后强弱关系不成立

distractors.text: Thereupon the king summoned Xiangru and asked: "The King of Qin offers fifteen cities for my jade—shall I refuse it?"
distractors.explanation: 「可予不」是「可以给他吗」，refuse 把问「给不给」换成问「拒不给」

distractors.text: Thereupon the king summoned Xiangru and asked: "The King of Qin offers fifty cities for my jade—shall I give it?"
distractors.explanation: 「十五城」是十五座城，fifty 把十五读成五十

distractors.text: Thereupon the king summoned Xiangru and asked: "The King of Qin demands fifteen cities for my jade—shall I give it?"
distractors.explanation: 「请易」是请求交换，demands 把「以城换璧」的对等交换读成索要

distractors.text: Xiangru said, "Qin is strong and Zhao is weak, so we must not agree to it."
distractors.explanation: 「不可不许」是双重否定，意为不得不答应；must not 把「不得不」读成「绝不能」

distractors.text: Xiangru said, "Qin is not strong and Zhao is weak, so we have to agree to it."
distractors.explanation: 「秦强而赵弱」是秦强赵弱，加 not 后前提被推翻

distractors.text: Xiangru said, "Qin is strong and Zhao is weak, so we may refuse it."
distractors.explanation: 「不可不许」是不可以不答应，may refuse 把结论译反

distractors.text: Xiangru said: "Qin asks the jade with cities, and if Zhao refuses the cities, the fault lies with Zhao.
distractors.explanation: 「赵不许」是赵国不答应给璧，refuses the cities 把拒绝的对象换成城

distractors.text: Xiangru said: "Qin asks the jade with cities, and if Zhao refuses, the fault lies with Qin.
distractors.explanation: 「曲在赵」是理亏在赵，lies with Qin 把责任方弄反

distractors.text: Xiangru said: "Qin asks the jade with cities, and unless Zhao refuses, the fault lies with Zhao.
distractors.explanation: 「而赵不许」是假设赵国拒绝，unless 把条件反了过来

distractors.text: The King of Zhao thereupon sent Xiangru bearing the jade, and they entered Qin from the west.
distractors.explanation: 「西入秦」是向西进入秦国，from the west 变成「从西边来」

distractors.text: The King of Zhao thereupon sent an envoy bearing the jade westward into Qin.
distractors.explanation: 「遣相如」派的是蔺相如本人，an envoy 把专使换成了泛称

distractors.text: The King of Zhao finally sent Xiangru bearing the jade westward into Qin.
distractors.explanation: 「遂」是于是就、随即，finally 把承接读成「终于」

distractors.text: Lin Xiangru saw that the King of Qin had no intention of repaying Zhao with a city in exchange for the stone, so he stepped forward and said, "There is a tiny flaw in this magnificent stone. Please allow me to show it to Your Majesty."
distractors.explanation: 「偿赵城」是给赵国城池作为抵偿，「repaying with a city」把交换关系读成还债

distractors.text: Lin Xiangru saw that the King of Qin had no intention of giving a city to Zhao in exchange for the stone, so he stepped forward and said, "There is a tiny crack in this magnificent stone. Please allow me to show it to Your Majesty."
distractors.explanation: 「瑕」是玉上的小斑点、瑕疵，crack 换成裂纹，性质不同

distractors.text: Lin Xiangru saw that the King of Qin intended to give a city to Zhao in exchange for the stone, so he stepped forward and said, "There is a tiny flaw in this magnificent stone. Please allow me to show it to Your Majesty."
distractors.explanation: 「无意偿赵城」是无意给城，删掉否定后整个动作的动机反了

distractors.text: So the King of Zhao purified himself for five days, had me bear the jade, and solemnly sent the letter of gift in the courtyard.
distractors.explanation: 「斋戒」是斋戒沐浴、洁净身心以备礼，purified 弱化成「洁净」；且斋戒含戒酒荤，非只净身

distractors.text: So the King of Zhao fasted five days, had me bear the jade, and solemnly sent the book of gift in the courtyard.
distractors.explanation: 「拜送书」的「书」是国书、文书，book 读成书籍

distractors.text: Only then did the King of Zhao fast five days, had me bear the jade, and solemnly sent the letter of gift in the courtyard.
distractors.explanation: 「乃」是于是就、便，Only then 读成「直到那时才」，语气变了

distractors.text: Xiangru guessed that the King of Qin would only use fraud to elaborately pretend to give the State of Zhao a city, but in fact it would be impossible for the State of Zhao to get it, so he said to the King of Qin: "He Shi Bi" is a treasure recognized by the world. The King of Zhao is afraid of your country and does not dare not to offer it.
distractors.explanation: 「详为」是假装做出（详通「佯」），elaborately 读成「精心地、详尽地」

distractors.text: Xiangru guessed that the King of Qin would only use fraud to pretend to give the State of Zhao a city, but in fact it would be impossible for the State of Zhao to get it, so he said to the King of Qin: "He Shi Bi" is a treasure legendary throughout the world. The King of Zhao is afraid of your country and does not dare not to offer it.
distractors.explanation: 「天下所共传宝」是天下公认、共同传诵的宝物，legendary 读成「传说中未必真有」

distractors.text: Xiangru guessed that the King of Qin would only use fraud to pretend to give the State of Zhao a city, but in fact it would be impossible for the State of Zhao to get it, so he said to the King of Qin: "He Shi Bi" is a treasure recognized by the world. The King of Zhao is afraid of your country and does not dare to offer it.
distractors.explanation: 「不敢不献」是双重否定、意为不得不献；删掉一个 not 后变成「不敢献」，正好相反

distractors.text: I truly feared to deceive Your Majesty and to fail Zhao, so I had a man carry the jade back, and it has already reached Zhao by a secret way.
distractors.explanation: 「见欺于王」是被大王欺骗，去掉被动后变成「欺骗大王」

distractors.text: I truly feared to be deceived by Your Majesty and to fail Zhao, so I had a man carry the jade back, and it has reached Zhao after an interval.
distractors.explanation: 「间至」是走小路、秘密地到达，after an interval 读成「隔了一段时间」

distractors.text: I truly feared to be deceived by Your Majesty and to fail Zhao, so I had a man carry the jade back, and it has not already reached Zhao by a secret way.
distractors.explanation: 「间至赵矣」是已经到了赵国，加 not 后变成还没到

distractors.text: Some attendants wished to lead Xiangru away, but the King of Qin said: "To kill Xiangru now would still not gain the jade, and would sever the friendship of Qin and Zhao; better to treat him generously on that account and send him back to Zhao. Would the King of Zhao deceive Qin for the sake of one piece of jade!"
distractors.explanation: 「引相如去」是拉他下去、拖走，lead away 弱化成「带走」

distractors.text: Some attendants wished to drag Xiangru away, but the King of Qin said: "To kill Xiangru now would still not gain the jade, and would secure the friendship of Qin and Zhao; better to treat him generously on that account and send him back to Zhao. Would the King of Zhao deceive Qin for the sake of one piece of jade!"
distractors.explanation: 「绝秦赵之欢」是断绝两国友好，secure 正好反义

distractors.text: Some attendants wished to drag Xiangru away, but the King of Qin said: "To kill Xiangru now would still gain the jade, and would sever the friendship of Qin and Zhao; better to treat him generously on that account and send him back to Zhao. Would the King of Zhao deceive Qin for the sake of one piece of jade!"
distractors.explanation: 「终不能得璧」是终究得不到璧，删掉 not 后变成「仍能得璧」，与「杀了也没用」的理由相反

distractors.text: Finally, Xiangru met him in the hall and completed the ceremony to let him return it to his country.
distractors.explanation: 「归之」是让（相如）回国，return it 把送人读成还物

distractors.text: Finally, Xiangru met him in the courtyard and completed the ceremony to let him return to his country.
distractors.explanation: 「廷见」是在朝廷（正殿）接见，courtyard 把朝廷读成庭院

distractors.text: Finally, Xiangru met him in the hall and completed the ceremony to let the King return to his country.
distractors.explanation: 「归之」的「之」指蔺相如，被送回的是相如，不是秦王

distractors.text: Lian Po sent him to the Qin border and said to the King of Zhao: "Your Majesty, I estimate that this trip will take no more than 30 days, including the travel time, the meeting ceremony, and the return time."
distractors.explanation: 「送至境」送到赵国边境，Qin border 把国境换成秦国边境

distractors.text: Lian Po sent him to the border and said to the King of Zhao: "Your Majesty, I estimate that this trip will take more than 30 days, including the travel time, the meeting ceremony, and the return time."
distractors.explanation: 「不过三十日」是不超过三十天，more than 把上限读成下限

distractors.text: Lian Po sent him to the border and said to the King of Zhao: "Your Majesty, I estimate that this trip will take no more than 13 days, including the travel time, the meeting ceremony, and the return time."
distractors.explanation: 「三十日」是三十天，13 把数字读错

distractors.text: The historian of Qin stepped forward and wrote: 'On such-and-such a day of such-and-such a month and year, the King of Qin and the King of Zhao drank together, and the King of Zhao ordered the King of Qin to play the zither.'
distractors.explanation: 「令赵王鼓瑟」是秦王命令赵王弹瑟，施受倒置后变成赵王命令秦王

distractors.text: The imperial envoy of Qin stepped forward and wrote: 'On such-and-such a day of such-and-such a month and year, the King of Qin and the King of Zhao drank together, and he ordered the King of Zhao to play the zither.'
distractors.explanation: 「御史」是史官（掌记事），imperial envoy 读成「使者」

distractors.text: The historian of Qin stepped forward with a letter and wrote: 'On such-and-such a day of such-and-such a month and year, the King of Qin and the King of Zhao drank together, and he ordered the King of Zhao to play the zither.'
distractors.explanation: 「前书」是上前书写记录，with a letter 把动作「书写」读成「带着书信」

distractors.text: Lin Xiangru came forward and said: 'The King of Zhao has overheard that the King of Qin excels in the music of Qin; may I present this basin to the King of Qin for our mutual entertainment?'
distractors.explanation: 「窃闻」是私下听说（谦辞），overheard 读成「偷听」

distractors.text: Lin Xiangru came forward and said: 'The King of Zhao has privately heard that the King of Qin excels in the music of Qin; may I ask the King of Qin to play this basin for our mutual entertainment?'
distractors.explanation: 「请奏盆缻秦王」是请（自己）献上盆缻给秦王，asks the King of Qin to play 把献器读成求秦王演奏

distractors.text: Lin Xiangru came forward and said: 'The King of Zhao has privately heard that the King of Qin excels in the music of Qin; may I present this basin to the King of Qin for the entertainment of the minister?'
distractors.explanation: 「以相娱乐」是让宾主相互取乐，for the minister 把「相」读成宰相

distractors.text: Then Xiangru stepped forward to offer the basin, and stood begging the King of Qin to play it.
distractors.explanation: 「跪请」是跪下请求，stood 把跪读成站

distractors.text: Then Xiangru withdrew to offer the basin, and kneeling begged the King of Qin to play it.
distractors.explanation: 「前进」是上前进献，withdrew 把「前」读成「退」

distractors.text: Then Xiangru stepped forward to offer the basin, and kneeling begged the King of Qin to accept it.
distractors.explanation: 「请秦王」是请秦王击缻（演奏），accept 把击缻读成接受

distractors.text: Xiangru said: "Within five paces, I beg to spatter my neck with blood!"
distractors.explanation: 「颈血溅大王」是拿我颈上的血溅到大王身上，spatter my neck 把施受倒置，成了溅自己脖子

distractors.text: Xiangru said: "Beyond five paces, I beg to spatter Your Majesty with the blood of my neck!"
distractors.explanation: 「五步之内」是五步距离之内，beyond 把「之内」译成「之外」，威胁的意思全失

distractors.text: Xiangru said: "Within five paces, I beg to spatter Your Majesty with the blood of my enemy!"
distractors.explanation: 「颈血」是以自己的颈血相胁，enemy 把「我的颈血」换成敌人的血

distractors.text: Thereupon the King of Qin, delighted, struck the basin once.
distractors.explanation: 「不怿」是不高兴，delighted 正好反义

distractors.text: Thereupon the King of Qin, unwilling, struck the basin twice.
distractors.explanation: 「一击缻」是敲了一下，twice 把一击读成两击

distractors.text: Thereupon the King of Qin, unwilling, declined to strike the basin.
distractors.explanation: 「为一击缻」是到底还是敲了一下，declined 把动作否掉

distractors.text: Xiangru turned and summoned the historian of Qin to write: "On such a year, month and day, the King of Qin struck the basin for the King of Zhao."
distractors.explanation: 「赵御史」是赵国的史官，historian of Qin 把记录方换成秦国

distractors.text: Xiangru turned and summoned the historian of Zhao to write: "On such a year, month and day, the King of Qin struck the basin for himself."
distractors.explanation: 「为赵王击缻」是为赵王击缻，for himself 把受惠者换成秦王自己

distractors.text: Xiangru turned and summoned the historian of Zhao to write: "On such a year, month and day, the King of Zhao struck the basin for the King of Zhao."
distractors.explanation: 「秦王为赵王击缻」是秦王为赵王击，主语被换成赵王，等于把这次外交胜利抹掉

distractors.text: Xiangru said: Please offer Xianyang from Qin as a gift to the King of Qin.
distractors.explanation: 「为赵王寿」是献给赵王祝寿，to the King of Qin 把受礼对象弄反

distractors.text: Xiangru said: Please offer Handan from Qin as a gift to the King of Zhao.
distractors.explanation: 「秦之咸阳」是秦国的咸阳（秦都），Handan 是赵国都城，地名错

distractors.text: Xiangru said: Please take Xianyang from Qin as a gift to the King of Zhao.
distractors.explanation: 「请以…为寿」是请（秦王）献出咸阳祝寿，take 把「献出」读成「取走」

distractors.text: Every time Xiangru went to the court, he often used illness as an excuse to hide at home, unwilling to compete with Lian Po in argument.
distractors.explanation: 「争列」是争位次、争班列，argument 把位次之争读成口舌之争

distractors.text: Every time Xiangru went to the court, he often fell ill, unwilling to compete with Lian Po for the order of precedence.
distractors.explanation: 「称病」是声称有病（托辞），fell ill 读成真的生病

distractors.text: Every time Xiangru went to the court, he often used illness as an excuse to hide at home, unwilling to compete with Lian Po for the order of battle.
distractors.explanation: 「列」是朝廷班次，order of battle 读成作战序列

distractors.text: Thereupon the retainers together remonstrated: "The reason we left our kin to serve you is that we envy your lofty righteousness.
distractors.explanation: 「慕」是仰慕，envy 读成嫉妒

distractors.text: Thereupon the retainers together remonstrated: "The reason we sent away our kin to serve you is that we admire your lofty righteousness.
distractors.explanation: 「去亲戚」是离开亲属，sent away 变成「把人送走」

distractors.text: Thereupon the retainers together remonstrated: "The reason we left our kin to serve you is that we admire your lofty wealth.
distractors.explanation: 「高义」是高尚的道义，wealth 把「义」读成「富」

distractors.text: Lin Xiangru firmly encouraged them, saying: 'In your judgment, how does General Lian compare with the King of Qin?'
distractors.explanation: 「固止之」是坚决制止他们，encouraged 把制止译成鼓励

distractors.text: Lin Xiangru firmly held them back, saying: 'In your judgment, how does General Lian compare with the King of Zhao?'
distractors.explanation: 「孰与秦王」的比较对象是秦王，King of Zhao 换成赵王

distractors.text: Lin Xiangru firmly held them back, saying: 'In your judgment, how does General Lian differ from the King of Qin?'
distractors.explanation: 「孰与」是「比…怎么样」，differ from 把比高低读成问差别

distractors.text: Lin Xiangru said: I was unable to reprimand the King of Qin in his court and humiliate his ministers despite his powerful prestige. I may not be talented, but am I afraid of General Lian alone?
distractors.explanation: 「廷叱之」是敢在朝堂上呵斥秦王，unable 把「做到了」改成「做不到」

distractors.text: Lin Xiangru said: I was able to reprimand the King of Qin in his court and humiliate his ministers despite his powerful prestige. I may not be talented, but am I afraid of the King of Qin alone?
distractors.explanation: 「独畏廉将军哉」是难道只怕廉将军，King of Qin 把对象换成秦王，反问失去针对

distractors.text: Lin Xiangru said: I was able to reprimand the King of Qin in his court and humiliate his ministers despite his weak prestige. I may not be talented, but am I afraid of General Lian alone?
distractors.explanation: 「秦王之威」是秦王的威势（极盛），weak 把褒贬读反

distractors.text: Confucius said: "What ugliness is there?"
distractors.explanation: 「陋」在此是简陋、鄙陋（指居室），ugliness 读成「丑陋」

distractors.text: Confucius said: "There is no crudeness at all."
distractors.explanation: 「何陋之有」是反问（有什么简陋的呢），改成陈述句后反问语气与「何」都丢了

distractors.text: Confucius said: "What crudeness is not there?"
distractors.explanation: 「何陋之有」是强调没有简陋，加 not 后变成「有什么不简陋」，意思反了

distractors.text: For love of the lotus, who is of one mind with the lotus?
distractors.explanation: 「同予者」是与我同道的人，换成 with the lotus 把同好对象弄错

distractors.text: For love of the lotus, who was of one mind with me?
distractors.explanation: 原句是当下的感慨，was 把现在译成过去

distractors.text: For love of the lotus, who is not of one mind with me?
distractors.explanation: 「同予者何人」是问「谁和我一样」，加 not 后变成「谁和我不一样」

distractors.text: Unless at noon or midnight, both sun and moon are seen.
distractors.explanation: 「不见曦月」是看不见日月，both...are seen 把否定译成肯定

distractors.text: Unless at noon or midnight, only the sun is seen.
distractors.explanation: 「不见曦月」是日月都看不见，only the sun 把「曦月」拆开只留日

distractors.text: If at noon or midnight, neither sun nor moon is seen.
distractors.explanation: 「自非」是「如果不是」，condition 被换成 if，条件关系反了

distractors.text: But there are few idle men like the two of us.
distractors.explanation: 「但」在此是「只、仅」，不是转折连词「但是」

distractors.text: Only there are many idle men like the two of us.
distractors.explanation: 「少闲人」是少有闲人，many 正好反义

distractors.text: Only there are not few idle men like the two of us.
distractors.explanation: 「少闲人」是闲人很少，加 not 后变成「闲人不少」

distractors.text: Thousand-li horses are always at hand, but Bo Le is not.
distractors.explanation: 「常有」是常有、不乏，always at hand 读成「随时都在手边」

distractors.text: Thousand-li horses are common, but Bo Le is.
distractors.explanation: 「伯乐不常有」是伯乐不常有，删掉否定后与全句「识才者难得」的主旨相反

distractors.text: Hundred-li horses are common, but Bo Le is not.
distractors.explanation: 「千里马」是千里马，hundred-li 把量级缩小十倍

distractors.text: Planned not by the right method, fed not to its full capacity, whistled at yet not understood—standing there with whip in hand, he says: "No good horse in the world!"
distractors.explanation: 「策之」是用鞭子驱赶、鞭策，planned 把「策」读成「计划」

distractors.text: Driven not by the right method, fed not to its full capacity, whistled at yet cannot make its meaning known—standing there with whip in hand, he says: "No good horse in the world!"
distractors.explanation: 「不能通其意」是人不能通晓马的意思，make its meaning known 把「人不懂马」读成「马表达不出」

distractors.text: Driven by the right method, fed not to its full capacity, whistled at yet not understood—standing there with whip in hand, he says: "No good horse in the world!"
distractors.explanation: 「策之不以其道」是不按正确方法驱赶，删掉否定后成了「方法正确」

distractors.text: If I cannot have both, I give away the fish and take the bear's paw.
distractors.explanation: 「舍鱼」是舍弃鱼，give away 读成「施舍、赠予」

distractors.text: If I can have both, I forsake the fish and take the bear's paw.
distractors.explanation: 「不可得兼」是不能两者兼得，删掉否定后前提不成立

distractors.text: Unless I cannot have both, I forsake the fish and take the bear's paw.
distractors.explanation: 「二者不可得兼」是既成前提，unless 把前提改成例外条件

distractors.text: If I cannot have both, I forsake life and take meaning.
distractors.explanation: 「取义」是选取道义，meaning 把「义」读成抽象的「意义」

distractors.text: If I can have both, I forsake life and take righteousness.
distractors.explanation: 「不可得兼」是不能兼得，删掉否定后前提被推翻

distractors.text: Unless I cannot have both, I forsake life and take righteousness.
distractors.explanation: 「二者不可得兼」是既定前提，unless 把前提改成例外

distractors.text: Life I desire, yet there is what I desire less than life; therefore I will not seize it by any base means.
distractors.explanation: 「有甚于生者」是有比生命更想要的，less than 把比较方向弄反

distractors.text: Life I do not desire, yet there is what I desire more than life; therefore I will not seize it by any base means.
distractors.explanation: 「生亦我所欲」是生命也是我想要的，加 not 后与后文「所欲有甚于生」失去对照

distractors.text: Life I desire, yet there is what I desire more than life; therefore I will seize it by any base means.
distractors.explanation: 「不为苟得」是不苟且取得，删掉否定后成了「不择手段去取」

distractors.text: Death I hate, yet there is what I hate less than death; therefore there are perils I do not shun.
distractors.explanation: 「所恶有甚于死者」是有比死更厌恶的，less than 把比较方向弄反

distractors.text: Death I love, yet there is what I hate more than death; therefore there are perils I do not shun.
distractors.explanation: 「死亦我所恶」是死亡是我厌恶的，love 把「恶」译成「爱」

distractors.text: Death I hate, yet there is what I hate more than death; therefore there are perils I do shun.
distractors.explanation: 「患有所不辟」是有灾祸不躲避，删掉否定后成了「都躲」

distractors.text: If what they desire of life surpasses that which they value, what means may not be employed to end existence!
distractors.explanation: 「可以得生」是可以求得生存，end existence 把「求生」译成「求死」

distractors.text: If what they desire of life surpasses that which they value, what means may be employed to sustain existence!
distractors.explanation: 「何不用也」是反问「什么手段不用」，删掉 not 后反问失去力度，成了「什么手段可用」

distractors.text: Unless what they desire of life surpasses that which they value, what means may not be employed to sustain existence!
distractors.explanation: 「如使」是假设「如果」，unless 换成否定条件「除非」

distractors.text: If what men hate were nothing worse than death, then what would they never do to escape peril?
distractors.explanation: 「何不为也」是反问「什么做不出来」，never do 把反问变成否定陈述

distractors.text: If what men hate were worse than death, then what would they not do to escape peril?
distractors.explanation: 「莫甚于死」是「没有比死更甚的」，删掉 nothing 后变成「比死更甚」，前提反了

distractors.text: Unless what men hate were nothing worse than death, then what would they not do to escape peril?
distractors.explanation: 「使」是假设「假使」，unless 换成否定条件

distractors.text: Hence there is what men desire less than life, and what they hate more than death.
distractors.explanation: 「所欲有甚于生者」是有比生命更想要的，less than 把比较方向弄反

distractors.text: Hence there is what men love more than life, and what they love more than death.
distractors.explanation: 「所恶有甚于死者」是有比死更厌恶的，第二个 love 把「恶」译成「爱」

distractors.text: Hence there is nothing men desire more than life, and what they hate more than death.
distractors.explanation: 「所欲有甚于生者」是确有比生更可欲的，nothing 把存在句否掉

distractors.text: In the morning, he dressed well, peeped at the mirror, and said to his wife, "Compared to Xu Gong in the north of the city, who is more beautiful?"
distractors.explanation: 「窥镜」是照镜子端详自己，peeped 读成「偷窥」

distractors.text: In the morning, he dressed well, looked in the mirror, and said to his wife, "Compared to Xu Gong in the south of the city, who is more beautiful?"
distractors.explanation: 「城北徐公」是城北的徐公，south 把方位弄反

distractors.text: In the morning, he dressed well, looked in the mirror, and said to his wife, "Compared to Xu Gong in the north of the city, who is not more beautiful?"
distractors.explanation: 「我孰与…美」是问谁更美，加 not 后问句重心变成「谁不更美」，答非所问

distractors.text: Ji lacked confidence, and further asked his concubine: "Who is handsomer, Lord Xu or I?"
distractors.explanation: 「不自信」是不相信（自己比徐公美）这个判断，不是「缺乏自信」这种性格描述

distractors.text: Ji did believe it, and further asked his concubine: "Who is handsomer, Lord Xu or I?"
distractors.explanation: 「不自信」是不信，删掉否定后成了「信了」，与「而复问其妾」的动作动机矛盾

distractors.text: Ji did not believe it, and further asked his concubine: "Who is handsomer, Lord Xu or my wife?"
distractors.explanation: 「吾孰与徐公美」的对手是徐公，不是自己的妻子

distractors.text: The concubine said: "How could Lord Xu fail to compare with you?"
distractors.explanation: 「何能及君」是「怎么能比得上您」，加 fail to 后成了「怎么会比不上您」，意思反了

distractors.text: The concubine said: "When could Lord Xu compare with you?"
distractors.explanation: 「何」在此是「怎么」表反问，when 读成疑问词「什么时候」

distractors.text: The concubine said: "How could Lord Xu compare with the King?"
distractors.explanation: 「及君」是比得上您（指邹忌），the King 把比较对象换掉

distractors.text: The guest said: "Lord Xu is more handsome than you."
distractors.explanation: 「不若君之美」是不如您美，more handsome 把「不如」译成「胜过」

distractors.text: The guest said: "The guest is not as handsome as you."
distractors.explanation: 「徐公不若君之美」的主语是徐公，换成 the guest 后成了客人自评

distractors.text: The guest said: "Lord Xu is as handsome as you."
distractors.explanation: 「不若」是不如，as...as 把「不如」译成「一样」

distractors.text: The next day Lord Xu came; Ji glanced at him and thought himself the lesser;
distractors.explanation: 「孰视之」是仔细端详（孰通「熟」），glanced 读成「瞥了一眼」

distractors.text: The next day Lord Xu came; Ji scrutinised him closely and thought himself the better;
distractors.explanation: 「自以为不如」是自认不如，the better 正好反义

distractors.text: The following month Lord Xu came; Ji scrutinised him closely and thought himself the lesser;
distractors.explanation: 「明日」是第二天，the following month 把次日读成下月

distractors.text: At night, lying abed, he pondered: "My wife calls me handsome because she fears me;
distractors.explanation: 「私我也」是偏爱我，fears 换成「怕我」，与后文「畏」的层次混淆

distractors.text: At night, lying abed, he pondered: "My wife calls me handsome because she pities me;
distractors.explanation: 「私」是偏爱，pities 换成「可怜」，三问三答的私／畏／求层次被打乱

distractors.text: At dawn, lying abed, he pondered: "My wife calls me handsome because she favours me;
distractors.explanation: 「暮寝」是晚上就寝，at dawn 把傍晚读成黎明

distractors.text: my guest calls me handsome because he has something to offer me.
distractors.explanation: 「欲有求于我」是有求于我，has something to offer 把「求人」变成「给人」

distractors.text: my guest calls me handsome because he wants something from my wife.
distractors.explanation: 「有求于我」是有求于我本人，换成 my wife 把求助对象弄错

distractors.text: my guest calls me handsome although he wants something from me.
distractors.explanation: 「客之美我者，欲有求于我也」是因果判断，although 改成让步，逻辑关系反了

distractors.text: Thereupon he entered the court to see King Wei and said: "I truly know I am more handsome than Lord Xu.
distractors.explanation: 「不如徐公美」是不如徐公美，more handsome 把不如译成胜过

distractors.text: Thereupon he entered the court to see King Wei and said: "I hardly know I am less handsome than Lord Xu.
distractors.explanation: 「诚知」是确实知道，hardly 把「确实」译成「几乎不」

distractors.text: Thereupon he entered the court to see King Xuan and said: "I truly know I am less handsome than Lord Xu.
distractors.explanation: 「威王」是齐威王，King Xuan 换成齐宣王，君王错

distractors.text: When the states of Yan, Zhao, Han, Wei, etc., heard of this matter, they all went to Qi to pay homage to the King of Qin.
distractors.explanation: 「朝于齐」是到齐国朝见齐王，King of Qin 把朝见对象换成秦王

distractors.text: When the states of Yan, Zhao, Han, Wei, etc., heard of this matter, only some of them went to Qi to pay homage to King Wei of Qi.
distractors.explanation: 「皆朝于齐」是都来朝见，only some 把全体译成部分

distractors.text: Before the states of Yan, Zhao, Han, Wei, etc., heard of this matter, they all went to Qi to pay homage to King Wei of Qi.
distractors.explanation: 「闻之」是听说了这件事之后才来朝，before 把先后关系倒置

distractors.text: This is what is meant by "winning without fighting" outside the court.
distractors.explanation: 「战胜于朝廷」是在朝廷之上（不动兵）取胜，outside 把场景挪到朝廷之外

distractors.text: This is what is meant by "won in battle" in the court.
distractors.explanation: 「战胜于朝廷」指不用出兵即令敌国宾服，won in battle 恰恰是动武取胜

distractors.text: This is not what is meant by "winning without fighting" in the court.
distractors.explanation: 「此所谓…」是肯定判断，加 not 后成了否定

distractors.text: Mencius said: How can he be called a great man?
distractors.explanation: 「是」指代景春所说的公孙衍、张仪一流，换成 he 把泛指收窄成个人

distractors.text: Mencius said: How can it be called a petty man?
distractors.explanation: 「大丈夫」是堂堂男子汉、大丈夫，a petty man 正好反义

distractors.text: Mencius said: Why can it be called a great man?
distractors.explanation: 「焉得为」是「怎么能算作」，why 换成问原因的「为什么」，反问力度消失

distractors.text: When rich and powerful, one should not be excessive; when poor and humble, one's will should not waver or change. Only those who face formidable forces and yield can be called great men!
distractors.explanation: 「威武不能屈」是威武不能使其屈服，and yield 把「不屈」译成「屈服」

distractors.text: When rich and powerful, one should be excessive; when poor and humble, one's will should not waver or change. Only those who face formidable forces without yielding can be called great men!
distractors.explanation: 「富贵不能淫」是富贵不能使他迷乱，删掉否定后与「大丈夫」的标准相反

distractors.text: Before rich and powerful, one should not be excessive; when poor and humble, one's will should not waver or change. Only those who face formidable forces without yielding can be called great men!
distractors.explanation: 「富贵不能淫」是「处于富贵时」的让步条件，Before 把状态读成时间先后

distractors.text: Jing Chun said: Are Gongsun Yan and Zhang Yi not truly petty men?
distractors.explanation: 「大丈夫」是堂堂大丈夫，petty men 正好反义，景春的赞叹变成贬斥

distractors.text: Jing Chun said: Were Gongsun Yan and Zhang Yi not real great men?
distractors.explanation: 原句是对当下人物的反问，were 把现在译成过去

distractors.text: Jing Chun said: Are Gongsun Yan and Zhang Yi real great men?
distractors.explanation: 「岂不诚…哉」是反问「难道不是真正的大丈夫吗」，删掉 not 后只剩疑问

distractors.text: Therefore, when Heaven is about to confer great responsibility on any man, it will exercise his mind with comfort, and his sinews and bones with toil, expose his body to hunger, and subject him to extreme poverty; it will confound his plans, so as to try his heart and see whether he is sincere, and to make the evil in his nature manifest. Then it will send some great opportunity to him, and see whether he equal to it.
distractors.explanation: 「苦其心志」是使他的心志痛苦，comfort 把「苦」译成「舒适」

distractors.text: Therefore, before Heaven is about to confer great responsibility on any man, it will exercise his mind with suffering, and his sinews and bones with toil, expose his body to hunger, and subject him to extreme poverty; it will confound his plans, so as to try his heart and see whether he is sincere, and to make the evil in his nature manifest. Then it will send some great opportunity to him, and see whether he equal to it.
distractors.explanation: 「天将降大任于是人也，必先…」的「先」是降任之前的磨炼，不是「在天要降任之前」，before 把主语事件挪了位

distractors.text: Therefore, when Heaven is about to confer great responsibility on any man, it will not exercise his mind with suffering, and his sinews and bones with toil, expose his body to hunger, and subject him to extreme poverty; it will confound his plans, so as to try his heart and see whether he is sincere, and to make the evil in his nature manifest. Then it will send some great opportunity to him, and see whether he equal to it.
distractors.explanation: 「必先苦其心志」是一定先让他心志受苦，加 not 后整段磨炼被否掉

distractors.text: Confucius said: Is it not a burden to learn knowledge and then review it at a certain time?
distractors.explanation: 「不亦说乎」是「不也很愉快吗」，burden 把「说（悦）」译成负担

distractors.text: Confucius said: Is it not a pleasure to learn knowledge and never review it at a certain time?
distractors.explanation: 「时习之」是按一定时间温习，never 把「时常温习」变成「从不温习」

distractors.text: Confucius said: Is it a pleasure to learn knowledge and then review it at a certain time?
distractors.explanation: 「不亦说乎」是反问式的强调，删掉 not 后失去反问语气

distractors.text: Zeng Zi said: I reflect on myself once every day: Do I do my best to do things for others?
distractors.explanation: 「三省」是多次反省，once 把「三」读成确数一次

distractors.text: Zeng Zi said: I reflect on myself many times every day: Do I do my best to do things for myself?
distractors.explanation: 「为人谋」是为别人谋划，for myself 把对象换成自己

distractors.text: Zeng Zi said: I reflect on myself many times every month: Do I do my best to do things for others?
distractors.explanation: 「吾日三省」是每天多次，every month 把「日」换成「月」

distractors.text: How can a person conceal this quality? Confucius said: To review what you have learnt and derive nothing new from it, then you can teach others based on this.
distractors.explanation: 「知新」是能有新体会，nothing new 把「知新」否掉，与「可以为师」矛盾

distractors.text: How can a person conceal this quality? Confucius said: To review what you have learnt and derive new understanding and realization from it, then you can be taught by others based on this.
distractors.explanation: 「可以为师」是可以做老师，be taught by others 把施受倒置

distractors.text: How can a person conceal this quality? Confucius said: To review what you have learnt and derive new understanding and realization from it, then you can become a disciple based on this.
distractors.explanation: 「为师」是当老师，disciple 换成当学生

distractors.text: I humbly reflect that the sagely dynasty rules the realm by filial piety: even aged former officials are denied compassion and care
distractors.explanation: 「犹蒙矜育」是尚且蒙受怜惜养育，are denied 把「受恩」译成「被剥夺」

distractors.text: I humbly reflect that the sagely dynasty rules the realm by force: even aged former officials receive compassion and care
distractors.explanation: 「以孝治天下」是以孝道治天下，by force 换成武力，与全篇「圣朝以孝治」的立论相反

distractors.text: I humbly reflect that the sagely dynasty rules the realm by filial piety: only young officials receive compassion and care
distractors.explanation: 「凡在故老」是凡是故旧老人，young officials 把「故老」换成年轻官员

distractors.text: I, in worn padded gown and ragged clothes, dwelt among them full of envy
distractors.explanation: 「略无慕艳意」是毫无羡慕之心，full of envy 正好反义

distractors.text: I, in fine robes and silk, dwelt among them without the least envy
distractors.explanation: 「缊袍敝衣」是破旧棉袍、破衣，fine robes and silk 把贫寒读成华贵

distractors.text: I, in worn padded gown and ragged clothes, dwelt among them with the least envy
distractors.explanation: 「略无」是丝毫没有，删掉「无」后成了「有少许羡慕」

distractors.text: for what sufficed to make me happy was within: I did not feel my food and clothing superior.
distractors.explanation: 「不若人」是不如别人，superior 把「不如」译成「胜于」

distractors.text: for what sufficed to make me happy was without: I did not feel my food and clothing inferior.
distractors.explanation: 「以中有足乐者」是内心（中）有足以自乐的事，without 把「中」读成「外」

distractors.text: for what sufficed to make me happy was within: I did feel my food and clothing inferior.
distractors.explanation: 「不知…不若人」是感觉不到自己不如人，删掉第一个否定后变成「感到不如人」

distractors.text: to say I vaunt my good fortune and am proud before my townsmen — that is to know me well!
distractors.explanation: 「岂知予者哉」是反问「难道算了解我吗」，know me well 把否定反问译成肯定

distractors.text: to say I vaunt my good fortune and am proud before my townsmen — that is to know me!
distractors.explanation: 「知予者」前的「岂…哉」是否定反问，删掉 not 后成了「算是了解我」

distractors.text: to say I vaunt my good fortune and am proud after my townsmen — that is to know me not!
distractors.explanation: 「骄乡人」是在同乡面前骄矜，after 把「面对」读成「在…之后」
